system.description:
Dry sand and bare rock under a hard sun. Water is rare and shade is rarer, and travel happens at dawn and dusk. People waste nothing and keep going when others would stop.

Talent: one Might die to d10, one Wit die to d10.

  • Dune Strider. +2 Training in Prowess.
  • Wrung Dry. +2 Training in Discipline.
